question: What alternative form and name characterize this supreme temple type?
premises: An alternative form is four-cornered by elegant proportion.
This form is called the supreme prosperity-increaser.
inference: The supreme prosperity-increaser type may alternatively be four-cornered with elegant proportions.
uncertainties: The exact sense of sauṣṭyaṃśena is interpretive.
plain_english: Alternatively, by elegant proportion it may be four-cornered; this is the supreme Śrīvardhana.
